comparisons.name: standard-light
comparisons.description: The standard 44 x 23 pt well at rest, a disabled one and one without a bezel, Aqua. No screenshot shows a standard well: its geometry is inferred and its colours are the ones measured on the toolbar well.

pixels.note: side hairline, black at 10.4% over #ececec (alpha measured on the format-bar well: #bdbdbd over #d3d3d3)
bezel band at mid height: half way from #fcfcfc to #f2f2f2 (measured gradient); that the band is 3 pt wide is inferred (spec: Standard well in a form)
1 pt frame between bezel and colour (spec: Inner frame, measured); at 1x the half-point border moves it
the colour the example sets
disabled: the colour at 50% over the bezel fill #f7f7f7 (spec: States, disabled, inferred)
without a bezel the colour reaches the corner of the 44 x 23 pt frame (AppKit isBordered, documented)

comparisons.name: standard-dark
comparisons.description: The standard well at rest, Dark Aqua: no outline, a translucent fill, a dark frame.

pixels.note: no outline in Dark Aqua: the window background shows up to the fill (measured on the format-bar well, row 146 x 651)
bezel band, white at 23% over #2f3032 (alpha measured: #67696c over the bar's #3a3c3f)
frame (spec: Inner frame, dark, measured)
the colour the example sets
disabled: the colour at 50% over the bezel fill #5f6061 (spec: States, disabled, inferred)

comparisons.name: active-light
comparisons.description: The well while the mouse is held down on it: the bezel darkens, the colour is unchanged. Aqua.

pixels.note: active bezel (spec: States, active, inferred)
the colour is unchanged
